svg.title: Systems engineering, software, and security
svg.desc: Systems software engineer: backend services, cloud infrastructure, and mobile apps. Distributed systems, low-latency media/control, concurrent event processing, blockchain, and parallel state-space search. Native clients, backend services, and protocols: scheduling, message ordering, backpressure, and idempotency under load. Embedded systems, control interfaces, live video/telemetry relays, custom input handling. Network infrastructure, VPNs, secure tunnels, self-hosted services, agentic systems. Research interests: Windows internals and APIs, browser sandbox escapes, firmware reversing, and code-execution chains. Authentication and WAF bypasses, parser differentials, protocol abuse, and automated reconnaissance. Cloud IAM misconfigurations, authorization bypasses, cross-tenant isolation. Software supply chain: package-manager execution-policy bypasses and CI/CD credential exposure. Tools: Burp Suite, Nmap, Wireshark, ffuf, Nuclei, Ghidra, WinDbg. Stack: Rust / Tokio · Go / Gin; Elixir / Phoenix / OTP; C++23 / Win32 / D3D11; Python / FastAPI · MCP · ONNX; React · Next.js · TypeScript; React Native · Flutter · Expo; Broadway · RabbitMQ · AMQP; Media transport · IPC · RPC; SQL · NoSQL · vector stores; Linux · Docker · VMware; Nginx · AWS / GCP; VPNs · Overlay Networks · P2P. 811 contributions, current streak 0 days, longest streak 9 days.
